definitions.gloss: cushioning material; packing material; shock-absorbing material
definitions.explanation: Material used to protect fragile items during shipping or storage, such as bubble wrap, foam peanuts, or air pillows.

examples.japanese: {緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pack it with cushioning material before shipping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{割|わ}れ→割る：02334_waru⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Since it's fragile, I used plenty of cushioning material.

examples.japanese: フリマ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}った→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発送|はっそう}する→発送する：21737_hassousuru⟧とき、{緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなくて→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: When shipping a product I sold on a flea market app, I was stuck because I didn't have enough packing material.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in shipping, packaging, and online commerce contexts. With the rise of online shopping and flea market apps like メルカリ, this word appears frequently in everyday life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in cushioning material)
- {緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (to wrap in packing material)
- {緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ (not enough cushioning material)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プチプチ→プチプチ：06847_puchipuchi⟧: bubble wrap — the colloquial onomatopoeic name for bubble wrap
- ⟦{梱包|こんぽう}{材|ざい}→梱包材：30141_konpouzai⟧: packing material — broader term for all packaging supplies
